title: CPCB (10 Nov 2026) says the gap between private apps' AQI and its National Air Quality Index comes from method differences, not under-reporting: index capped at 500 by design (Severe 401–500), 24-hour average vs hourly app readings, analysers installed in 2015 calibrated to 1,000 µg/m³ so higher hourly readings are left out; post-Diwali screenshots showed apps at 1,500–1,800 for Delhi while CPCB stayed below 400
